in_latin.name: Karlyn
in_latin.meaning: a name of Germanic origin, derived from Karl, meaning free man
in_latin.long_meaning: a name of Germanic origin, derived from Karl, meaning free man, Karl is a shortened form of names containing the element karl, which is derived from the Old High German word karl, meaning free man. The name Karlyn is a variant of Karl, which has been used in various forms since the Middle Ages.
